name: Every operator and verifier list change is audited
summary: operators/verifiers add|remove take --actor/--reason. A change appends an entry to authority-changes.audit.json (0600, 200 kept) under the lock first. Every history begins with a baseline of the lists as they stood; an unreadable one is null (UNKNOWN). An ADD starting a history with an unreadable list is refused; a REMOVAL never is, for the audit or the OTHER list. authority-changes: replay.agrees is false when a comparable list disagrees, null (incomplete) when not compared, or no trail. authority-changes-baseline records the verdict on the replaced history in the baseline's rebased_over FIELD, lists .replaced-* under replaced_files, and REFUSES a mismatch or damaged history without --accept-unexplained; incomplete/null needs no flag. Re-bases and the cap fold copy rebased_over forward, keeping the FIRST and newest seven and counting the rest in dropped; the reader prints it with ever_rebased_over_mismatch. A damaged audit never refuses a REMOVAL: the bytes go beside it first. Placeholders are refused on an ADD (re-checked under the lock), dropped on a REMOVAL, recorded unattributed. NOT covered: a hand edit of deployment.private.json; a change by an older kit.
